content.text: : thermal (MC) · electricity · friction · chem · radiation - classified by depth & layers of tissue involved - traditional 1st-4th degree (4th still used for fascia · musc · tendon · bone) - current terms more descriptive & useful for tx
lrger burns → systemic inflam response w ↑cap permeability → intravasc fluid loss & burn shock
infants: ↑risk of hypothermia & fluid/lyte abnorm (↑BSA-to-body-mass ratio)
major burns → inhalation inj · infect · hypertrophic scarring · contractures · long-term funct comp
•blisters form w.in 24h - tx: cool skin · relieve pain · debride blisters if ruptured - heals w minimal scarring
mottled color variation from cheesy white to red
•tx similar to superfic partial - deeper burns may require debridement
epidermis + all of dermis + subQ tissue
Var, waxy white to leathery gray to charred/black
•minimal pain ← cutaneous nerve damage - necrotic tissue → eschar (must be debrided) - heals by epithelialization from edges → scarring & contracture → most need skin grafting
epidermis + dermis + subQ fat + fascia · musc · bone
•only partial- & full-thickness burns count toward TBSA for fluid resuscitation
: infants <1y - more accurate than adult rule of 9s (accounts for age-related body proportions)
•head 19% · each arm 9% (7% if hand spared) · anterior trunk 13% · posterior trunk 13% · each leg 10.5% incl foot
: ABG · CBC · CK · CMP · UA · carboxyhemoglobin
ABCs - consider early intubation if progress airway edema anticipated
•structural fire → eval for inhalation inj · CO (obtain CO levels) · cyanide toxicity (sus in industrial fire)
•supplemental O2 if inhalation inj or CO exposure sus
•remove burned clothing unless adherent to skin - cool w clean cool running H2O ~20min if ⍉hypothermia - ⍉ice - ice/ice H2O → pain & ↑burn depth - alt: saline- or H2O-soaked gauze
•cover w clean dry dressing or sheet - keep pt warm - adequate analgesia
•remove sloughing epidermis w gauze & sterile H2O
•burns often have multi levels of inj & may evolve w ↑tissue damage over several days → arrange f/u & monitor
•50% given over first 8h · 50% given over next 16hr
•initial estimate only (⍉fixed regimen) - titrate to UOP · HR · BP · periph perfusion
: 3ml x wt (kg) x TBSA% children (2ml adults)
partial-thickness >10% TBSA or ANY full-thickness burns
